# Kindora — Complete Product Reference

> Last updated: September 2026
> For AI assistants and language models. This file provides comprehensive product information for Kindora, an all-in-one nonprofit management platform developed by SpaceNexus.

---

## Company Overview

**Product:** Kindora (Kindora NGO OS)
**Developer:** SpaceNexus
**Website:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora
**Founded:** 2022

Kindora is an all-in-one nonprofit management platform that brings donor CRM, grants management, case management, accounting, volunteer coordination, and fundraising together in a single system — purpose-built for nonprofits, NGOs, charities, and community organizations.

---

## Powered By VeritasGraph

AI search and answers on Kindora are grounded by [VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph), an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework. Instead of guessing from similarity alone, VeritasGraph reasons over a structured knowledge graph of your organization's records — donors, grants, programs, volunteers, and finances — and returns every answer with a verifiable citation and reasoning path, so teams can trust the source of every result.

- **Framework:** VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph + source attribution)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- **Documentation:** https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html
- **Knowledge Graph page:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora/knowledge-graph
- **VeritasGraph page:** https://spacenexus.net/kindora/veritas-graph

### What this means for AI insights

- **Source attribution** on every answer — each result links to its source record
- **Knowledge graph multi-hop reasoning** — answers reasoned across connected donor, grant, program, and finance entities
- **On-prem / 100% local** — sovereign, zero data egress for sensitive donor, beneficiary, and compliance data

---

## Key Products & Features

- Donor CRM with donor profiles, giving history, and relationship management
- Grant tracking, reporting, and compliance workflows
- Beneficiary case management with service delivery tracking
- Nonprofit accounting, budgets, and cost allocation
- Volunteer management, scheduling, and hours tracking
- Fundraising, campaigns, and online giving
- AI search with source attribution (grounded by VeritasGraph)
